days.title: Peaks and Monasteries of the Desert
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: pico Bartolo
stops.detail: Located in the southeastern area of the province of Castellón, having the Bartolo peak at 729 m above sea level as its maximum height.

stops.name: Monasterio antiguo
stops.detail: The presence of the Carmelite order has provided the park with two important monuments such as the old Monastery (in ruins) (17th-18th century) and the new Monastery (18th century); several hermitages (18th-20th centuries) are also scattered throughout the site.

days.title: Historical Ruins and Sierra Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: sierra de Les Santes
stops.detail: The park, together with the nearby Les Santes mountain range, forms part of an anticlinal fold of Paleozoic materials.

stops.name: Castillo de Montornés
stops.detail: Additionally, in the park there are a series of important ruins such as the Montornés Castle, the Miravet Castle, and the Les Santes Hermitage.
